name: Views Addons
description: Adds a few extra handlers to Views: an unfiltered custom-text field and an "add entity" link area.
project_description:
Additional handlers for Drupal Views. Two things:

Advanced Custom Text — a Views field handler (views field id 'views_addons_custom_advanced') that behaves like the core Custom Text field but relaxes the tag filtering so extra HTML tags (svg, g, circle, text by default, and any others the administrator adds) survive rendering. Core's Custom Text field runs its output through Xss::filterAdmin(); this handler replaces that with strip_tags() against an administrator-configurable allow-list.

Add Entity Link — a Views area handler (views area id 'views_addons_add_entity', usable in Header / Footer / No-results areas) that renders an access-checked link to the add form of a chosen node type, user, or taxonomy term / vocabulary. Link text and CSS classes are configurable; the link is only shown to users who pass the entity createAccess() check.
